data.description: 王都城堡的屋顶上，三笠迎着夕阳而立，绿色披风与红围巾同时被风托起，她微微抬头望向墙外的方向——「总有一天，我们要走出这些墙。」
data.promptProse: High atop the steeply pitched slate roof of a royal capital castle at dusk, Mikasa stands steady in her Survey Corps uniform, green cloak, and ODM harness. Turning her face slightly upward toward the horizon beyond the distant walls, she lets the brisk evening wind billow her cape and lift the trailing ends of her red scarf. Low golden sunset light rims her profile and straps against drifting amber clouds.
data.title: 三笠 · 自由之翼下
data.animaCaption: Standing atop the steep castle roof tiles in her Survey Corps uniform and green cloak, Mikasa gazes toward the distant horizon as evening wind lifts her cape and red scarf. Low golden sunset light rims her profile against the amber sky.
